content: Written 2026-10-06 18:14, self-approved. After queue12 (real row 4 v3 on c5fef9f, evaluated, stop rule applied): the other rows on the SAME code c5fef9f, so every row's snapshots use the first-echo readout (R2) and every row has median-TSDF exports: (1) real row 3, (2) real row 1, (3) synthetic row 4 (only if real row 4 v3 is not GT-worse; else after A1 is reverted, on that commit), (4) synthetic row 1, (5) synthetic row 3. One job at a time, eval_row.sh right after each, six claims + figures after each.

eval/reemit_final.py re-renders only the final snapshot (only the session-end maps are checkpointed); the change, ghost and retention scores also read the in-session and boundary snapshots, so 'the same readout for every row' needs the rows re-mapped. Real row 1 has no checkpoints (run 08:30, before checkpoints were kept), so its median column needs the rerun anyway.

Rows 1 (scratch) and 3 (own update) have no layer: T1 is off (alive_at = None), G5 and the T1 birth change (457de84) are not on their path; A1 is identical for them (own update had detect_additions already; alive_at(now) = None renders every Gaussian, as before). git log 5aa4b28..c5fef9f -- backends/game run.py frames.py: only R2 (first echo) changes their output. Sources and eq. 5 check of R2/A1: prerun_review_row4_c5fef9f_20261006.csv.
As the row-4 review: depth median/scale in m, measured-depth pixels, 2 cm / 1 cm voxels; flat.yaml for real (GAME_CONFIG), the synthetic default config for synthetic, unchanged.

eval_row.sh unchanged for every row (real: G1 surfel + median TSDF, G2, D2/D3, ghost, retention + retention_correct, Object F1 Table 1 variant, D1 person; synthetic: geometry, state eval, retention, object F1, D1). compare_rows.py puts rows 1/3/4 side by side; make_figures.sh draws them.
real_row3v2, real_row1v2, syn_row4v3, syn_row1v2, syn_row3v2: checkpoints per session, timelines, run.json, eval dirs, logs; code_c5fef9f archive (shared with queue12).

queue12's smokes ran c5fef9f real A->B->C and synthetic A->B through the full eval chain with row 4 (the row with the most code on its path). Rows 1/3 add no code path the smoke did not run except own update's detect_removals, which the published rows 1/3 ran unchanged at 5aa4b28 (real and synthetic, exit 0).

Real rows 3 / 1 took 1 h 52 / 1 h 38 at 5aa4b28; synthetic rows ~25 min each; evals ~40 / ~20 min. VRAM peaks as before (refinement ~14-15 GB); gate_run2.sh, GPU.lock, nothing else on the GPU. OOM: one unchanged rerun, else stop.

Mapping as at 5aa4b28 (not bit-reproducible): its final surfel G1@5 should be near the final-only first-echo re-emission of row 3 (P/R A 90.35/95.47, B 77.38/95.81, C 76.09/97.41), within 1 pp; D2/D3 and ghost now from first-echo snapshots: D2 FPs not above E1's (A 1, C 1); ghost B/C below E1's 31.6 / 40.5 (the first echo drops blended free-space samples).
Scratch: no history, unobserved retention near the E1 run's (B 23.70 / C 29.67, readout-independent in kind); its median-TSDF G1 is the missing column.

Row 3 final G1 differs from its re-emission by > 1 pp: mapping changed although it should not (check the code path before anything else). A job failing: fix the cause, rerun. These rows are baselines, so no stop rule applies to their own numbers; the claims are judged on row 4 vs them.
